sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI release notes place the introduction of cached prompts in May 2025, before the models.dev observation; they do not state Grok 3 Mini Fast cache rates or an exact effective date.

sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the **cached prompt token price**, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the [Pricing](/developers/pricing) page for current prices.
sources.supports: xAI confirms cached prompt billing is model-specific, but this current documentation does not establish the June 2025 official Grok 3 Mini Fast rate.

notes: The provider’s release notes show caching was available by May 2025, but the available primary sources do not establish whether Grok 3 Mini Fast’s earlier listing omitted nonzero official cache rates or whether those rates were introduced later. The requested classification and effective date therefore remain unclear; no usable archive snapshot establishing the earlier model-specific rates was retrieved.
